name: Microchip Auto Glass
old_description: We understand how frustrating it can be when your windows fail to function properly, whether it’s a stuck window or a regulator that makes strange noises. Our team specializes in both repairs and full replacements, ensuring that we get your windows working like new. With our expertise and attention to detail, you can trust us to restore the comfort and convenience of your vehicle’s windows without the need for expensive replacements.
about:
Microchip Auto Glass has operated from Tacoma, Washington since 2010. The company provides mobile auto glass repair and replacement services across the greater Puget Sound region, traveling to customers in cities including Seattle, Bellevue, Olympia, and surrounding communities. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop performs windshield replacement for passenger vehicles and semi-trucks, door glass replacement, sunroof replacement, window regulator repair and replacement, and ADAS calibration following glass replacement or collision work. Technicians use what the company describes as state-of-the-art equipment for recalibrating advanced driver assistance systems. Service vehicles carry inventory for on-site installation, and the company notes a courtesy vacuum cleaning step during door glass jobs to remove residual glass from interiors and door cavities.

Customers range from individual vehicle owners to commercial fleets operating Peterbilt, Freightliner, Kenworth, Volvo, International, and Mack trucks. The fleet program emphasizes minimal downtime for businesses with multiple vehicles. The company also serves heavy-duty truck operators requiring windshield replacement that meets sealing and structural standards for long-haul operation.

Microchip Auto Glass distinguishes itself through mobile service delivery, a relatively uncommon focus on regulator and sunroof repairs, and ADAS calibration capability that many general glass shops do not offer. A warranty backs all windshield replacements, and the company highlights its ability to handle both passenger car and Class 8 truck glass work from the same mobile platform.
